products.name: Holistic AI
products.note: Bias auditing, risk management, compliance; strong technical depth; mid-market focus

profile_text.body:
Holistic AI is an enterprise software company that provides an AI governance platform designed to help organizations discover, assess, and manage AI systems across their technology environments. The company describes itself as offering an end-to-end tool that automatically scans cloud platforms, code repositories, and SaaS applications to build an inventory of AI systems, including shadow AI, and continuously tests those systems for security, bias, performance, robustness, explainability, and safety risks. The platform includes built-in frameworks for the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and NYC Local Law 144, and the company says it automates compliance workflows and generates audit evidence without requiring manual processes.

The platform covers bias auditing, risk management, and regulatory compliance, and includes capabilities such as AI red teaming with adversarial testing, jailbreak resistance, and prompt injection detection, as well as a supervisory layer for agentic AI that monitors behavior and intervenes when risk thresholds are crossed. Unilever is cited on the company's site as a customer, with a quoted representative describing Holistic AI's platform as central to Unilever's responsible AI strategy and noting that new AI projects at Unilever are assessed with Holistic AI's involvement. MindBridge is also cited as a customer.

The site references recognition from Everest Group, CB Insights, Avasant, and Forrester, each positioning the company favorably within the AI governance category. The held facts list one tracked product under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category, consistent with the company's single-platform focus. No litigation, MCP server presence, SEC filings, or patent records are noted in the available data.
